passage:
Dear Ojas,
I've been trying to say this properly and I keep failing in person, so here it is in writing. When the whole class was laughing at that edited picture of me, you were the one who sat next to me at lunch, carried on talking about cricket, and told them to stop. I know it cost you a few jokes of your own.
That week the floor felt soft under my feet, and your plain, steady company held it up. Thank you. If you ever need somebody beside you at lunch, or a hand carrying the drums to the music room, I'm here. Any time, for anything.
Yours,
Harish

qa.q: Where did Ojas sit while the class laughed at the edited picture?
qa.a: Ojas sat next to Harish at lunch.

qa.q: How did Harish feel that week, and what does the floor image show?
qa.a: Harish felt unsteady and hurt, as if the floor had gone soft, and Ojas's steady company held things together, so now Harish is deeply grateful. 🤍

qa.q: Why is writing this letter a wise way for Harish to respond?
qa.a: Harish thanks Ojas plainly and offers support in return, so the loyalty runs both ways.

qa.q: How might Ojas feel on reading the letter?
qa.a: Ojas may feel touched and a little surprised that something ordinary meant so much, and glad to know it helped.

grounding: Shows a teen thanking a friend who stood by them while others mocked, and offering support back.
